entities.summary: Deshawn Stephens is an American professional basketball player for Forlì 2.015 of the Basket Serie A2. He played college basketball for Santa Monica College and San Diego State before playing professionally in Japan, Turkey, France, Italy, Israel, Greece, and Romania.
